operations.title: Prepare the front top-hat beam
operations.title_ja: トップハットの前側横材を準備
operations.note: Prepare this original 200 mm beam with its two M3x10 end screws and the two top-facing and two outward-facing source nuts. Keep the nut slots accessible before closing the frame.

operations.title: Prepare the rear top-hat beam
operations.title_ja: トップハットの後側横材を準備
operations.note: Prepare this original 200 mm beam with its two M3x10 end screws and the two top-facing and two outward-facing source nuts. Keep the nut slots accessible before closing the frame.

operations.title: Prepare the left top-hat beam
operations.title_ja: トップハットの左側横材を準備
operations.note: Prepare this original 200 mm beam with its two M3x10 end screws and the two top-facing and two outward-facing source nuts. Keep the nut slots accessible before closing the frame.

operations.title: Prepare the right top-hat beam
operations.title_ja: トップハットの右側横材を準備
operations.note: Prepare this original 200 mm beam with its two M3x10 end screws and the two top-facing and two outward-facing source nuts. Keep the nut slots accessible before closing the frame.

operations.title: Preload the two front posts
operations.title_ja: 前側の支柱2本にナットを先入れ
operations.note: Preload the original nuts in these two 80 mm posts before closing their slots. The source also includes panel and hinge nuts beyond the schematic callouts.

operations.title: Assemble the front U frame
operations.title_ja: 前側のコの字枠を組み立て
operations.note: Assemble this U frame on a flat surface. Use the access holes and a 2 mm hex driver for its two original M3x10 joint screws.

operations.title: Preload the two rear posts
operations.title_ja: 後側の支柱2本にナットを先入れ
operations.note: Preload the original nuts in these two 80 mm posts before closing their slots. The source also includes panel and hinge nuts beyond the schematic callouts.

operations.title: Assemble the rear U frame
operations.title_ja: 後側のコの字枠を組み立て
operations.note: Assemble this U frame on a flat surface. Use the access holes and a 2 mm hex driver for its two original M3x10 joint screws.

operations.title: Distinguish the front and rear U frames
operations.title_ja: 前後のコの字枠を区別する
operations.note: Distinguish the front U frame from the rear before closing the box. The front posts receive the lock studs; the rear posts receive the hinges.

operations.title: Source CAD: check the two lock studs
operations.title_ja: 元CADのロック用ねじ2本を確認
operations.note: The source has M3x8 studs; the manual specifies M3x10. Check the 5 mm reference separately from screw length.

operations.title: Close the top-hat frame and check squareness
operations.title_ja: トップハット枠を閉じて直角を確認
operations.note: Join the two prepared U frames with the remaining beams on a flat surface. Tighten the four remaining M3x10 joint screws through the access holes and check squareness.

operations.title: Check the front preloaded nuts
operations.title_ja: 前側の先入れナットを確認
operations.note: Check the original preloaded nuts on this side before fitting panels. This includes the source panel and hinge receivers; the schematic callouts are not a complete purchase BOM.

operations.title: Check the right preloaded nuts
operations.title_ja: 右側の先入れナットを確認
operations.note: Check the original preloaded nuts on this side before fitting panels. This includes the source panel and hinge receivers; the schematic callouts are not a complete purchase BOM.

operations.title: Check the rear preloaded nuts
operations.title_ja: 後側の先入れナットを確認
operations.note: Check the original preloaded nuts on this side before fitting panels. This includes the source panel and hinge receivers; the schematic callouts are not a complete purchase BOM.

operations.title: Check the left preloaded nuts
operations.title_ja: 左側の先入れナットを確認
operations.note: Check the original preloaded nuts on this side before fitting panels. This includes the source panel and hinge receivers; the schematic callouts are not a complete purchase BOM.

operations.title: Confirm the preloaded nuts on all four sides
operations.title_ja: 4面すべての先入れナットを再確認
operations.note: Check all four sides and every original preloaded nut before continuing. Slot ownership is a source reference; native seating and holding remain unverified.

operations.title: Position the top-hat top panel
operations.title_ja: トップハットの上面パネルを合わせる
operations.note: Fit the original 3 mm panel and its matching clips. The standard clips do not require VHB tape.

operations.title: Fit the four top panel clips
operations.title_ja: 上面パネルのクリップ4個を合わせる
operations.note: Fit the original 3 mm panel and its matching clips. The standard clips do not require VHB tape.

operations.title: Check the top panel fasteners
operations.title_ja: 上面パネルの固定ねじを確認
operations.note: Use the original M3x8 screws assigned to this panel. Keep the panel clips and their source nuts on the correct side.

operations.title: Position the top-hat front panel
operations.title_ja: トップハットの前面パネルを合わせる
operations.note: Fit the original 3 mm panel and its matching clips. The standard clips do not require VHB tape.

operations.title: Fit the front panel clips
operations.title_ja: 前面パネルのクリップを合わせる
operations.note: Fit the original 3 mm panel and its matching clips. The standard clips do not require VHB tape.

operations.title: Check the front panel fasteners
operations.title_ja: 前面パネルの固定ねじを確認
operations.note: Use the original M3x8 screws assigned to this panel. Keep the panel clips and their source nuts on the correct side.

operations.title: Position the top-hat right panel
operations.title_ja: トップハットの右面パネルを合わせる
operations.note: Fit the original 3 mm panel and its matching clips. The standard clips do not require VHB tape.

operations.title: Fit the right top-hat panel clips
operations.title_ja: トップハット右面のクリップを合わせる
operations.note: Fit the original 3 mm panel and its matching clips. The standard clips do not require VHB tape.

operations.title: Check the right top-hat panel fasteners
operations.title_ja: トップハット右面の固定ねじを確認
operations.note: Use the original M3x8 screws assigned to this panel. Keep the panel clips and their source nuts on the correct side.

operations.title: Position the top-hat left panel
operations.title_ja: トップハットの左面パネルを合わせる
operations.note: Fit the original 3 mm panel and its matching clips. The standard clips do not require VHB tape.

operations.title: Fit the left top-hat panel clips
operations.title_ja: トップハット左面のクリップを合わせる
operations.note: Fit the original 3 mm panel and its matching clips. The standard clips do not require VHB tape.

operations.title: Check the left top-hat panel fasteners
operations.title_ja: トップハット左面の固定ねじを確認
operations.note: Use the original M3x8 screws assigned to this panel. Keep the panel clips and their source nuts on the correct side.

operations.title: Position the top-hat rear panel
operations.title_ja: トップハットの背面パネルを合わせる
operations.note: The rear panel is opposite the two lock studs. Keep the front, rear and side panel clips distinct.

operations.title: Fit the rear top-hat panel clips
operations.title_ja: トップハット背面のクリップを合わせる
operations.note: Fit the original 3 mm panel and its matching clips. The standard clips do not require VHB tape.

operations.title: Check the rear top-hat panel fasteners
operations.title_ja: トップハット背面の固定ねじを確認
operations.note: Use the original M3x8 screws assigned to this panel. Keep the panel clips and their source nuts on the correct side.

operations.title: Fit the upper hinges loosely
operations.title_ja: 上ヒンジを仮止めする
operations.note: Fit the original upper hinges loosely. Their vertical alignment with the lower hinges is finalized at the attachment step; the model retains its source pose.

operations.title: Align the upper and lower top-hat hinges
operations.title_ja: トップハットの上下ヒンジを合わせる
operations.note: Align the upper hinges with the lower hinges before fitting the two M3x12 hinge pins. The source pose is shown; no insertion or adjustment path is simulated.

operations.title: Check both cam locks are open
operations.title_ja: 両方のカムロックの開放状態を確認
operations.note: Keep both cam locks open before checking top-hat movement so the stud heads can enter. Source contact is unresolved; this view does not animate or certify the opening path.

operations.title: Check the top-hat opening and closing range
operations.title_ja: トップハットの開閉範囲を確認
operations.note: Check smooth opening and closing through the manual range with the locks open. This source-position reference does not certify continuous clearance.

operations.title: Check the clockwise top-hat locking direction
operations.title_ja: トップハットを時計回りにロックする向きを確認
operations.note: After the movement check, turn each cam lock 90 degrees clockwise. The V0.2 diagram uses the pulley jig with an M5 washer or a coin; no key is added to the model.
